review.startupPrompt:
This task uses the independent ReelTerminal Review Workspace. CLI prefix: {{cli}}
Explicit current target: {{target}}

1. Run {{cli}} review context to discover this run's workspace/instance identity and access.
2. Run {{cli}} review describe and {{cli}} review capabilities for review commands and the actual allowed media roots.
3. Use {{cli}} schema review.ingest or schema review.apply for exact parameters. Create nodes with review.nodes.create. Writes require an explicit review target, expected revision, and UUID requestId. Prepare files inside the allowed roots; do not put media bytes in JSON.
4. Submit with {{cli}} review call review.ingest --file <request-file>, then read back with review.get / review.changes / review.versions.get. review.apply reuses the workbench operation vocabulary shown in its schema and remains bound to the independent review node.

Review write access is granted separately by this workspace's control. Discover the target again after restarting. The user confirms publication in the UI. Use review.export.* for frozen file copies, review.steps.* for actual processing records, and review.package.inspect/restore for portable recovery. Read each verb schema before submitting.

collaboration.startupPrompt:
Collaborate on the current ReelTerminal desktop project through its live CLI. Use {{shell}} and this complete prefix on every invocation: {{cliCommand}}

First run:
{{cliCommand}} status
{{cliCommand}} call capabilities.get
{{cliCommand}} context --compact

If context reports enabled collaboration instructions, read their complete text with collaboration.instructions.get. Read pending tasks with requirements list/get. Bind related reads and edits to the same projectId and workspaceId. Refresh context before each round of work and before edits; reread instructions when their summary changes.

Use the revision from the planning read, project identity and supported safety guards. Discover parameters with schema <command>. On conflicts, resolve the target and plan again rather than blindly retrying. Preserve the project format and existing state unless I request changes or replacement.

Use capabilities.get recommendedRoot for files (path at copy time: {{workspaceRoot}}) and follow its directory and import boundaries. The CLI reads credentials automatically; never print or copy tokens. Copy a fresh prompt after installation or storage paths change.

Continue with my request after reading context; if no specific request is present, ask what I want to do.

collaborationInstructions.title: Collaboration instructions
collaborationInstructions.emptyDescription: Add habits you want the Agent to follow in this project. Start with one, or leave this empty.
collaborationInstructions.presetHint: Choose a preset, edit its wording, then add it to this project. Nothing is enabled automatically.
collaborationInstructions.noReferences: No assets or clips are available in this project.
collaborationInstructions.scope: This project only · Added by you
collaborationInstructions.required: Enter a title and detailed instruction.
collaborationInstructions.placeholder: Fill in the preset placeholders marked with 【】 first.
collaborationInstructions.conflict: This instruction has changed. Return to the list and reopen it before editing.
collaborationInstructions.limit: A project can have at most 20 collaboration instructions.

visual.title: Guide me visually
visual.description: When I dislike the overall direction or cannot describe my preferences, offer a few distinct key frames or short motion prototypes. Let me compare one design question at a time before expanding production.

explain.title: Explain through visual changes
explain.description: Use the creation, connection, transformation and comparison of graphics to explain ideas. Use text for labels and emphasis; avoid relying mainly on successive static title cards.

sample.title: Try a short segment first
sample.description: For changes to overall style, structure or motion language, produce a representative short segment for direction review before expanding production.

compare.title: Offer comparable alternatives
compare.description: Offer a few alternatives for the same content, describe their main differences and focus each round on one design question. Let me express preferences by choosing and pointing.

preserve.title: Preserve what I approved
preserve.description: Keep approved design choices in subsequent edits and limit the scope of changes. Explain the reason and impact before changing an approved part.

review.title: Review inside the project
review.description: Locate and preview edits on the current timeline. Export the whole video only when I request file delivery. Rendering intermediate animation assets is still allowed.

resources.title: Check existing assets and methods
resources.description: Check relevant project assets and the personal library when planning. Reuse suitable resources and methods, and verify tool availability rather than assuming library notes prove it.

tool.title: Prefer a specific tool
tool.description: For 【purpose, such as concept images】, prefer 【tool, such as local Moss-Image】. Check availability first. Explain when it is unavailable or unsuitable and propose an alternative.

skill.title: Use a specific animation skill
skill.description: For code animation, use 【skill name or path】. Reference 【asset and range, plus the qualities to borrow】 for visual direction. The skill handles implementation; the reference informs design.
